payload.posture: Read Micah 4:1–8 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states a later-days vision answers the prior ruin with streamed peoples, instruction, peace, and secure dwelling. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
